name: China Three Gorges Renewables (Group) Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Three Gorges Renewables (Group) Co.,Ltd. engages in the development, investment, and operation of wind and solar energy in China. The company develops offshore wind power projects with a cumulative installed capacity of 7.0498 million kilowatts, onshore wind power projects with a cumulative installed capacity of over 7.5 million kilowatts, photovoltaic power stations with a cumulative installed capacity of over 7 gigawatts, and small and medium-sized hydropower project with an installed capacity of 220 megawatts. China Three Gorges Renewables (Group) Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is based in Beijing, China.
